contract:
Imports loadViewerFollowedOrgIds and loadVisibleOrgCards (type OrgCard) from F1's following.ts, and createSupabaseServiceClient.

src/lib/iu/community-scope.ts (stays pure):
- Add `export const FOLLOWED_ORG_FILTER_CAP = 50` next to :294. The docblock states the URL budget: 300 author uuids is about 11.1 KB already (:286-294), 50 club uuids adds about 1.9 KB, and blocked/muted ids come on top. The ids arrive newest follow first, so the newest 50 are kept, and the route logs any truncation.
- feedLaneOrFilter(lane, followedAuthorIds: string[] = [], followedOrgIds: string[] = []) (:358). Inside `if (lane.includeFollowed)` (:369-372), after the user_id clause: ids = unique isUuid-filtered followedOrgIds, .slice(0, FOLLOWED_ORG_FILTER_CAP); if non-empty, parts.push(`org_id.in.(${ids.join(",")})`). This is a parameter, NOT a FeedLane field (C10). FeedLane (:296-318) and feedLaneFor (:334-349) stay unchanged, and trending/hashtags/route.ts:92 and campus-request.test.ts:197 need no edit.
- postInFeedLane(post: {user_id?; org_id?: string|null; campus_id?; school_system?}, lane, followedAuthorIds, followedOrgIds: ReadonlySet<string> = EMPTY_SET) (:384-401). The final return ORs in (lane.includeFollowed && typeof post?.org_id === "string" && followedOrgIds.has(post.org_id)).
- scoreFeedRow(post: {...existing, org_id?: string|null}, nowMs, viewerFollowingIds, homeCampusId, followedOrgIds: ReadonlySet<string> = EMPTY_SET) (:467-489). Replace :485 with `if (viewerFollowingIds.has(post.user_id) || (post.org_id != null && followedOrgIds.has(post.org_id))) score *= 1.6;`. That is ONE 1.6, the larger of the two boosts, never their product. Update the docblock at :424-464.
- NEW `export function feedDiversityKey(post: {user_id: string; org_id?: string|null}): string` returns post.org_id ? `org:${post.org_id}` : `user:${post.user_id}` (C1).

src/app/api/feed/route.ts:
1. The Promise.all at :153-162 gains followedOrgsRes = loadViewerFollowedOrgIds(supabase, user.id) (user client). If !ok: console.error("[feed followed-orgs]") and 500 {ok:false, error:"Request failed"}, the same fail-closed rule as :178-181.
2. const service = createSupabaseServiceClient(). If there are followed ids: visible = await loadVisibleOrgCards(service, ids); if !ok, 500 "Request failed". followedOrgIds = ids.filter(id => visible.byId.has(id)), order kept, so hidden clubs leave the lane and the boost. If followedOrgIds.length > FOLLOWED_ORG_FILTER_CAP, console.warn("[feed] followed orgs truncated", {count}). followedOrgSet = new Set(followedOrgIds).
3. :210 becomes feedLaneOrFilter(lane, Array.from(viewerFollowingIds), followedOrgIds).
4. Posts select (:218-221): REMOVE "org:orgs(id,handle,name,logo_url,verified,is_public)". Reposts select (:251-255): REMOVE its nested org embed; reposts only feed engagement counts (:382-387). PostRow (:44-61) loses `org`. After this nothing in the file embeds `orgs` under the user client (C2, M1d contract :131-152).
5. :294-296 becomes postInFeedLane(p, lane, viewerFollowingIds, followedOrgSet).
6. After postRows: attrIds = unique non-null org_id values. If any, attribution = await loadVisibleOrgCards(service, attrIds); if !ok, 500 "Request failed" (precedent: events/route.ts:290-306). In renderPost (:345-374) replace :352 and :370-372 with: card = row.org_id ? attribution.byId.get(row.org_id) ?? null : null; org: card ? {...card, logo_url: orgAssetProxyUrl(card.handle, card.logo_url, "logo")} : null. A hidden or unknown club gives org null, and the card renders as its author. Output keys stay {id,handle,name,logo_url,verified,is_public}; hidden_at is never sent.
7. :401 becomes scoreFeedRow(entry.post, now, viewerFollowingIds, homeCampusId, followedOrgSet).
8. :417 becomes `const key = feedDiversityKey(entry.post);`, and the comment at :409-412 is corrected. Do NOT write `entry.post.org_id` alone: all 21 live posts have a null org_id, so that would cap the whole feed at 3.
9. No new response field.

Stated behaviour:
- A viewer with no verified university gets {kind:"everything"} (:341), so the club clause adds nothing, but following still boosts ranking.
- A blocked or muted officer's posts as a followed club stay out through :239-241.
acceptance: `node --test --experimental-strip-types src/lib/iu/community-scope.test.ts` passes, with new tests: the org clause appears only when includeFollowed (home lane yes; laneFor("iu-bloomington", IU_INDY) gives exactly "campus_id.in.(iu-bloomington)"); {kind:"everything"} still gives null; the club list is capped at FOLLOWED_ORG_FILTER_CAP; non-uuid and injection strings never reach the filter; an empty lane with empty ids is still "id.is.null"; the 2-argument call yields the same string as before (trending and campus-request unchanged); postInFeedLane admits a followed club's post from another campus in the home lane and rejects it in a browse lane; scoreFeedRow for a followed author posting as a followed club equals 1.6 times the base, not 2.56 times; feedDiversityKey gives distinct keys for two personal posts by different users and the same key for two posts by one club from different officers.
`npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, including trending/hashtags/route.ts and campus-request.test.ts with no edits. `grep -n "org:orgs" src/app/api/feed/route.ts` returns nothing.

Prod, read-only, as Franky: /api/feed?limit=50 returns 200 with the same post ids as before the diff (0 club posts live, so nothing about attribution changes). A page of personal posts from several authors is not cut to 3 (C1 regression check).

On a Supabase branch or local stack: seed one SAE post by SAE's officer. A non-member whose home campus is NOT Indianapolis (so the campus rule can't be what lets it in) follows SAE, and the post appears with org {handle:"sae", name, logo_url}. After unfollowing it is gone. As an Indianapolis viewer it appears through the campus rule either way and gets the 1.6 boost only while followed. Hide the club: its post shows org null and it no longer enters through the follow rule. With loadVisibleOrgCards forced to fail, the response is 500, not an unattributed page.
